collegeReviews.infrastructureDesc: University has beautiful infrastructure with all the required facilities. It is providing cafeteria facility, wifi connectivity, stationary facility, library facility, smart classrooms and laboratories with all the necessary equipments.
collegeReviews.placementDesc: The placement quality of university is superb. Top most companies of the sector visit campus for job offer. The average package of B.tech all branches combined is around 4-5 lakhs which is much better than other institutes.
collegeReviews.academicDesc: University runs on a updated curriculum includes all the recent developments in the field. The organised curriculum making students job-ready. Personalized mentor is alloted to all the students who analyses the progress student.
collegeReviews.medianSalaryDesc: It costs 1 lakh for Electronics and communication engineering, For Other branches the fee is quite higher. In my opinion my money is totally worthy here as I am meeting personal mentorship, good academic knowledge and personal development activities.
collegeReviews.campusDesc: I have great campus life experience here. Here the bond between teacher and student is superb. For the all round development development of students, university organises many academic and cultural events. For emergency,students are provided with a emergency number.
